definitions.gloss: funds allocated on top of a previously approved budget; a supplementary or additional budget
definitions.explanation: Money added to an existing budget after the original plan has been set. Used in both government finance (supplementary national budgets) and private-sector contexts (project cost overruns, new requirements requiring extra spending).

examples.japanese: {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧になった。
examples.english: An additional budget became necessary for the project.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The government announced that it would put together an additional budget for disaster recovery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{資材|しざい}→資材：19470_shizai⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{当初|とうしょ}→当初：12503_tousho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見積|みつも}り→見積り：04699_mitsumori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧{追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Due to rising material costs, approval is being sought for an additional budget exceeding the original estimate.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧ (addition; adding on) + ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧ (budget). A straightforward compound used in both public and private finance contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧: to put together an additional budget
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply for additional budget
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to enter an additional budget into the books
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}する→承認する：20064_shouninsuru⟧: to approve an additional budget
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ: additional budget is required
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧: a request for additional budget

RELATED GOVERNMENT-FINANCE TERMS:
- ⟦{補正|ほせい}{予算|よさん}→補正予算：15579_hoseiyosan⟧: supplementary budget — the technical Japanese-government term for a formal revision of the national budget after it has passed the Diet.
- ⟦{当初|とうしょ}→当初：12503_tousho⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: original / initial budget
- {本|ほん}⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: the main budget
- ⟦{暫定|ざんてい}→暫定：05626_zantei⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧: provisional budget
- ⟦{予備|よび}{費|ひ}→予備費：30230_yobihi⟧: reserve funds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {追加|ついか}{予算|よさん}: general term for any extra budget added to a plan.
- ⟦{補正|ほせい}{予算|よさん}→補正予算：15579_hoseiyosan⟧: the specific legal term for a supplementary national budget in Japan; always refers to the government.
- ⟦{増額|ぞうがく}→増額：12134_zougaku⟧: an increase in amount — focuses on the change, not the resulting budget.
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦{超過|ちょうか}→超過：04523_chouka⟧: over budget — describes the state of having exceeded the budget, not the extra allocation itself.

USAGE:
- Project management: when cost estimates rise or new requirements emerge
- Government finance: disaster response, economic stimulus, unforeseen expenses
- Academic research: grants requiring extra funds mid-project
- Construction: cost overruns due to material or labor prices
